rationale: With the police helicopter's flight complete, we are launching two drones to cover critical gaps and high-priority hazards. Drone 1 will survey the unscanned FiDi URM-infill block at One Sansome Street, which holds over 9,000 occupants and a 65% predicted collapse risk. Drone 2 will verify an active fire at 201 California St and inspect trapped survivors reported at 100 Battery St, California Bank and Trust, and 350 Bush St, while Drone 3 remains in reserve for follow-ups.
